description: Optimal planning of autonomous electric vehicles charging stations with photovoltaic generations and energy storage systems is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Tayenne Dias de Lima, Haider Ali. This database contains technical information on the 69-bus electrical distribution system. This system was tested in a mixed integer linear programming model for allocating autonomous electric vehicle charging stations equipped with photovoltaic generation and energy storage systems. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
